message.content:
**Light Theme**

**(1) Broken/illegible/clipped text — FAIL (minor)**
- Nothing truly broken, but the red chip "مقدمة في الخوارزميات" has very low-contrast red-on-pink text — hard to read.
- Header breadcrumb "المراجعة والتقارير |" nearly touches the right edge; the pipe separator sits flush against the viewport edge.
- "اختبار قصير" / "اختبار نهائي" labels touch the card's inner right border.

**(2) Contrast of seats/chips — PASS**
- All badges/chips ("سؤالان 20 دقيقة", "مراجعة") have adequate text contrast on light backgrounds.

**(3) Spacing/alignment — PASS (minor notes)**
- Large empty band between the stats row and "قائمة الانتظار" card (top padding asymmetry).
- "تقارير الجودة" button is oddly centered in the header row rather than aligned with title/label.

**(4) Unstyled elements — PASS**
- Everything looks custom-styled (buttons, chips, search box); no default browser look.

---

**Dark Theme**

**(1) Broken/illegible/clipped text — FAIL (minor)**
- Same red chip issue, worse here: dark red text on dark-red/maroon chip is hard to read.
- Same right-edge crowding of breadcrumb and "اختبار" labels.

**(2) Dark-on-dark / low-contrast seats — FAIL**
- "مقدمة في الخوارزميات" chip: dark red text on dark maroon — dark-on-dark, borderline illegible.
- Stats cards (#2/3) are slightly darker than page background with faint borders — very low separation, close to dark-on-dark.
- "فقد كلمة..." links in dark red on dark card are low contrast.

**(3) Spacing/alignment — PASS (minor)**
- Same minor issues as light (empty gap before card, centered "تقارير الجودة").

**(4) Unstyled elements — PASS**
- No unstyled/default elements; theme consistently applied.

---

**Summary:** Both themes are largely well-formed; main failures are the low-contrast red "مقدمة في الخوارزميات" chip in both themes (critical in dark) and slight edge crowding on the right.
